ABOUTABOOUT

Real Cases. 24 Hours. Real Impact.

On 13 November Proximata hosts its flagship hackathon, jointly organised with START Vienna and Home of InnoVation. Real cases from real companies give you and your team 24 hours to build something truly disruptive. Meet leaders of the ecosystem, experts from top industries, and exceptional builders.

AGENDAAGENDA

Two Days. One Build.

Fri · 13 Nov

Kick-off & build

12:00

Keynote panel with Hubert Rhomberg, CEO of Rhomberg

Hubert Rhomberg, CEO of Rhomberg, gives a panel talk at HOIV before the build starts.

14:00

Hackathon start

24 hours to build something truly disruptive, in person at HOIV – Home of InnoVation in Vienna.

Sat · 14 Nov

Pitch & award

11:00

n8n & Adaption workshops

An n8n workshop, plus a 30-minute online session with an Adaption engineer on training a model from your own data.

15:00

Code freeze

Building stops and every team submits its project.

16:00

Winner announcement & demos

Each case partner picks a Track Winner. The Track Winners pitch in front of an external jury of VCs, founders, and tech leads.

18:00

Closing

The hackathon wraps up on Saturday at 18:00, followed by networking.
